##### Project general facts

Elano by ORO24 embodies the art of urban living, reinvented for those who want their home to reflect their personality and style. The residential tower offers a thoughtfully designed collection of studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, each crafted with intention and purpose. From the moment residents walk through the door, every space feels like a true reflection of unique taste, ready to be made their own.

Life at Elano by ORO24 is defined by curated living, with an impressive lineup of amenities designed for relaxation, fitness, and fun. Residents can enjoy a 30-meter swimming pool with outdoor cinema, cabana seating, a grand entrance lobby, a stylish party hall, and beautifully landscaped gardens with barbeque stations and water features. The lively O-zone completes the experience with a health club, sauna, steam room, library, virtual golf, indoor basketball, gaming arcade, karaoke, billiards, table tennis, and more, offering something enjoyable for every mood and every day.

Inside, Elano by ORO24 welcomes residents with warm, elegant interiors featuring soft neutral palettes, natural wood tones, and sleek modern fittings. Kitchens and living spaces are finished with clean lines and quality materials that create a comfortable, sophisticated atmosphere throughout the home. Every detail, from the curated décor to the thoughtfully designed layout, has been chosen to help residents feel a true sense of pride and belonging in their own dream home.

##### Location description and benefits

Arjan is a thriving and rapidly developing district in Dubai, known for its well-planned layout, vibrant atmosphere, and proximity to some of the city’s most famous attractions. Located between Al Barsha South and Dubai Motor City, it offers seamless connectivity to key highways, making travel across the emirate quick and convenient. The area’s growing infrastructure and urban planning make it a prime location for both residents and investors seeking long-term value.

One of Arjan’s key advantages is its blend of modern residential communities and abundant green spaces. Home to landmarks like Dubai Miracle Garden and Dubai Butterfly Garden, the district offers a unique combination of city living and natural beauty. With schools, healthcare facilities, retail outlets, and leisure options within easy reach, Arjan provides everything needed for a comfortable and self-sufficient lifestyle.

The community is also known for its variety of residential projects, ranging from stylish apartments to upscale developments with premium amenities. This diversity attracts a mix of families, young professionals, and investors. With its strategic location, appealing surroundings, and continuous growth, Arjan stands out as one of Dubai’s most promising and desirable areas to live and invest in.
